prior_year_events.event_name: 2023 RiverStone RITC and Quota Share True-up
prior_year_events.impact_description: true up process resulted in a GBP 27.1m charge in the profit and loss during the finalisation of the RITC and quota share arrangement

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a net strengthening of GBP 72.5 million in prior year reserves, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This includes a specific GBP 27.1 million charge in profit and loss related to the true-up of the 2023 RiverStone Reinsurance to Close (RITC) and quota share arrangements. Historically, excess claims inflation has been a factor, though it is considered a reduced risk for the current year.
raw_causal_phrases: This true up process resulted in a GBP 27.1m charge in the profit and loss during the finalisation of the RITC and quota share arrangement.

excess claims inflation not captured in the historical development is considered a reduced risk to the adequacy of reserves relative to last year, given developments in the economic and legislative environment.
